Claude — connect Mindy

In the Claude desktop or web app. This is the easy one.

1
Open Settings.

Click your name in the bottom-left corner, then click Settings (or press Cmd + ,).

2
Go to Connectors.

In the Settings window, look down the left sidebar. Under Customize, click Connectors.

3
Click "Add", then "Browse connectors".

The Add button is at the top right of the Connectors page.

4
Find Mindy and click "Connect to Claude".

Search mindy, open the Mindy result, and click the orange Connect to Claude button.

5
Create your free Mindy account.

A Mindy window opens. Create a free account — 100 credits, no card — with Google, Microsoft, or email. (Already have one? Just sign in.)

6
Allow the connection.

Mindy asks to connect to your account. Click Allow.

7
Connected!

Back in Claude you will see Mindy marked Connected with a green check.

8
Set Mindy to "Always allow" (recommended).

By default Claude asks permission on every Mindy call. On the Mindy connector page, open the Read-only tools dropdown and choose Always allow so Mindy just works.

✅ That's it for Claude. Ask: Use Mindy to find contracts expiring in my NAICS in the next 6 months.
Don't see Mindy in the directory? In the Add menu choose Add custom connector and paste: https://mcp.getmindy.ai/mcp

ChatGPT — connect Mindy

On the web (chatgpt.com). More steps than Claude — do them once, in order.

1
First, turn on Developer mode.

You must do this before you can add Mindy. Go to Settings → Security and login → Developer mode and switch it on. You will see an "elevated risk" warning — that is ChatGPT's standard notice for any custom tool. Mindy is safe; continue.

2
Now go back to Plugins and add Mindy.

With Developer mode on, the custom-plugin option now works. Open Plugins (chatgpt.com/plugins), click the + at the top right. Name it Mindy, set Connection → Server URL to the address below, set Authentication to OAuth, agree to continue, and click Create.

https://mcp.getmindy.ai/mcp
3
Click "Sign in with Mindy".

This is the step that connects the plugin to your account.

4
Create your free Mindy account (or sign in).

A Mindy window opens. Create a free account — 100 credits, no card — or sign in if you already have one. When you finish, it connects back to ChatGPT automatically.

5
Allow permissions.

Choose what Mindy is allowed to do. Pick Allow low-risk actions (the default) — Mindy can pull federal data without nagging you, and still asks before anything sensitive.

6
Done — Mindy is connected.

You will see Mindy connected, with its permissions set. Turn it on in a chat and ask away — same as Claude.

✅ That's it for ChatGPT.
